text:
As Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Shares Rose, Shareholder Segantii Capital Management LTD Has Upped Its Position; Cumberland Partners LTD Holds Position in Hanesbrands (HBI) 
April 12, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
Simon Sadler increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 183.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Segantii Capital Management Ltd bought 27,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Simon Sadler held 42,500 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.33M, up from 15,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Segantii Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $452.33B market cap company. The stock increased 0.39% or $0.68   $176.04. About 5.00 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since April 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500. 
Andrew Wallach increased its stake in Hanesbrands Inc (HBI) by 81.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cumberland Partners Ltd bought 689,305 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.94% with the market. The hedge fund run by Andrew Wallach held 1.54 million shares of the clothing and shoe and accessory stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $32.18 million, up from 849,550 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cumberland Partners Ltd who had been investing in Hanesbrands Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.78 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.11% or $0.02   $18.8. About 1.00 million shares traded. Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) has declined 8.16% since April 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.71% the S&P500. 
Among 21 analysts covering Hanesbrands ( NYSE:HBI ), 10 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 48% are positive. Hanesbrands had 60 analyst reports since September 17, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) earned “Buy” rating by Buckingham Research on Thursday, November 2. The stock of Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) has “Conviction Buy” rating given on Friday, December 4 by Goldman Sachs. On Friday, October 16 the stock rating was initiated by Oppenheimer with “Outperform”. Morgan Stanley maintained Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) rating on Monday, August 7. Morgan Stanley has “Equal-Weight” rating and $24 target. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Monday, July 17 by Buckingham Research. The stock of Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) earned “Buy” rating by UBS on Friday, February 5. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Friday, April 6 by Bank of America. The stock of Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) earned “Hold” rating by Macquarie Research on Monday, April 2. The company was maintained on Friday, February 9 by Deutsche Bank. On Monday, October 26 the stock rating was downgraded by DA Davidson to “Neutral”. 
Since February 15, 2018, it had 0 buys, and 1 sale for $1.07 million activity. 
Investors sentiment decreased to 1.11 in Q4 2017. Its down 0.04, from 1.15 in 2017Q3. (NYSE:HBI) for 10,191 shares. Dubuque State Bank Trust owns 0% invested in Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) for 168 shares. Garrison Financial Corp invested 0.66% of its portfolio in Hanesbrands Inc. Pub Employees Retirement Of Ohio has 201,753 shares. Bbva Compass Bancshares holds 112,688 shares. Foundation Resources has 16,697 shares. Cumberland Partners Ltd, which manages about $759.83 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Pembina Pipeline Corp (NYSE:PBA) by 25,089 shares to 922,639 shares, valued at $33.54M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Agrium Inc (NYSE:AGU) by 4,260 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 233,070 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 38 analysts covering Alibaba ( NYSE:BABA ), 36 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 95% are positive. Alibaba had 171 analyst reports since August 12, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Wedbush maintained it with “Neutral” rating and $80 target in Wednesday, October 28 report. Morgan Stanley maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, January 29 report. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, August 12 by Brean Capital. The firm has “Buy” rating by Jefferies given on Friday, February 2.
